text:
morgan: Quick UX check — opening a tool result from run list breaks keyboard flow. Tab through runs -> open result -> next Tab focuses big "Re-run with tools" CTA instead of panel content.

alex: Can repro on Chrome. We were auto-focusing the CTA to announce it to SRs, but that's hurting keyboard nav.

jules: Which element should get focus then? Header link or first interactive in the panel?

morgan: Header link feels right. Also closing the slide-over doesn't reliably return focus to the initiating run item.

sam: Seen on Firefox/Win too. Pattern should be: on open -> focus logical first element in panel; on close -> return focus to initiator.

lee: Proposal: programmatically focus a tabbable panel heading (aria-labelledby), announce status via aria-live polite and avoid CTAs as initial focus. Add an offscreen skip-link at top of run history.

alex: Agree. Also change copy: shorten "Run again with tools" -> "Re-run" and add accessible tooltip (aria-describedby) for longer description.

jules: Accessibility nit: JSON viewer reads as one blob. Render each function output as collapsible sections with aria-expanded and aria-controls so SR users can navigate per-function.

morgan: Also increase chevron contrast on dark theme (current ~3.8:1) to meet 4.5:1 and add a visible 2px focus ring on run items.

sam: I'll add a puppeteer test: open panel, close panel, assert document.activeElement is original run button.

lee: I'll prototype header-focus + collapsible outputs and update color tokens.

alex: I'll author PR with accessibility checklist and tests, deploy to sandbox and ping PM/CS for validation.

designbot: Reminder: slide-over focus return required (pattern lib rule 4.3). Include changelog notes for aria-live and contrast tweaks.
